title: Pen and Ink at the Brandywine
content: Thomas Nast, Charles Addams, Charles Schulz, and Rube Goldberg are among the artists featured inLaugh Lines: Cartoons and Caricatures from the Collection, on view at the Brandywine River Museum through March 14.Above: Tony Sarg, Laughing Lion, 1930.The exhibition includes over 50 humorous works by some of the most important illustrators from the 19th and 20th centuries, whose works comment on politics, society and ordinary life.Visitor's information: Entrance fees, directions, hours, etc.
